title: Task record
description: A task record that only the core writes. The sender sends the body (task-body); the schema rejects a request with any record field (IDN-1). The record belongs to exactly one tenant, and it does not change (TEN-1). There are five stored states: rejected is an answer to an enqueue, and there is no task record with it. Task lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/task.md.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; the pair (tenant, idempotency_key) stays unique even after the task is deleted (IDM-1).

initiator.description: The principal on whose behalf the task runs: a person, an external program service, or system.

initiators.description: Set of initiators: the initiator and the initiators of everything the attempt read; the attempt permissions are intersected with all of them (PRM-6).

enqueued_by.description: Who enqueued it: a channel, a worker with an attempt, a schedule, a route, the core.

origin.description: Where to reply: the channel and chat, signed by the core on intake. Not part of the attempt work item (SEC-4).

channel.description: Name of the channel through which the task came.

conversation.description: Opaque conversation id computed by the core from origin.

depth.description: Depth in the task tree, at most 5 (PRM-6).

continues.description: The task that this one continues; only the core sets it, on a reply or within the continuation window (CNT-5).

untrusted_seen.description: Untrusted flag; it is only set, never cleared (INJ-13).

untrusted_source.description: Source of the untrusted flag, for example logs/tail or goal:service.

personal_subjects.description: Principals whose personal data is in the body, attachments or result.

approval_id.description: Approval number of an action.<a> task (CNT-7).

to_group.description: Bot group the task is addressed to (D5).

priority_class.description: Priority class: 1 control, 2 interactive, 3 normal, 4 batch, 5 background (DSP-5).

fairness_key.description: Dispatcher fairness key <kind>:<id> from the task source; the core writes it on every task from v0.1 (DSP-2, D-98), and it orders dispatch from v0.2 (DSP-6).

reason.description: Reason for the final state from the reason registry, for example attempts_exhausted or initiator (result canceled(initiator)).

lease_no.description: Number of the last lease; grows with each claim.

attempts_spent.description: Spent attempts; compared with retry.max_attempts, ceiling 3.

runs_counted.description: Runtime runs with a model answer; compared with retry.max_runs, ceiling 6.

waiting_reason.description: Why a task in submitted is not handed out right now.

run_at.description: Time before which the task is not handed out (retry pause).

followup_until.description: End of the continuation window after a result with need_input: true (CNT-5).

pin.description: Pinning to a worker; only the control lane writes it (D12).
